courses.summary: 矽光子生物感測器以表面感測、參考通道與檢出限連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Silicon-photonic biosensors links device physics and system validation through surface sensing, reference channels and detection limits. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以表面感測、參考通道與檢出限比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through surface sensing, reference channels and detection limits, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 多重矽微環生物感測研究
history.text: Nature Communications / research authors 的「電光矽生物感測器」提供可追溯的發展案例。它支援本課的原理與設計問題；課程算例另行設定，並不冒充該研究的性能。研究事件與地圖的封裝代表據點分開標示，不主張兩者發生在同一地點。
history.textEn: Nature Communications / research authors: The electrophotonic silicon biosensor provides a traceable development example. It informs the principles and design questions; course calculations use separate assumptions and do not claim that study's performance. The research event and the representative packaging location are distinct and are not claimed to share a site.

history.title: 從單元件指標到可測試系統
history.titleEn: From component metrics to testable systems
history.text: 本課把表面感測、參考通道與檢出限放在材料、介面及封裝的連續證據鏈中。下列原始研究與機構資料呈現不同發展路線；此欄是教學脈絡，並非宣稱此地的發明年表。
history.textEn: This course puts surface sensing, reference channels and detection limits within a continuous evidence chain of materials, interfaces and packaging. The primary studies and institutional records show different development routes; this is learning context, not a claimed invention timeline for this location.
